metadata.name: Klondike Draw 3
metadata.description: Single-player Klondike solitaire with a draw-three stock.

actions.name: DrawThree
actions.predicate: Action.source.label = D1 and Action.destination.label = C1 and Action.source.count >= 3 and Action.count = 3

actions.name: DrawRemainingCards
actions.predicate: Action.source.label = D1 and Action.destination.label = C1 and Action.source.count > 0 and Action.source.count < 3 and Action.count = Action.source.count

actions.name: RecycleWaste
actions.predicate: Action.source.label = C1 and Action.destination.label = D1 and GameState.Zones["D1"].count = 0 and GameState.Zones["C1"].count > 0 and Action.count = Action.source.count

actions.name: FlipTableauCard
actions.predicate: Action.source.type = Tableau and Action.source.visibility = Hidden and Action.destination.type = Tableau and Action.destination.visibility = Public and Action.source.attributes.column = Action.destination.attributes.column and Action.source.count > 0 and Action.destination.count = 0

actions.name: TableauToEmptyTableau
actions.predicate: Action.source.type = Tableau and Action.source.visibility = Public and Action.destination.type = Tableau and Action.destination.visibility = Public and Action.source.attributes.column != Action.destination.attributes.column and Action.source.count > 0 and Action.destination.count = 0 and Action.count > 0 and Action.count <= Action.source.count and Action.source.cardFromTop(Action.count).rank = 13

actions.name: TableauToTableau
actions.predicate: Action.source.type = Tableau and Action.source.visibility = Public and Action.destination.type = Tableau and Action.destination.visibility = Public and Action.source.attributes.column != Action.destination.attributes.column and Action.source.count > 0 and Action.destination.count > 0 and Action.count > 0 and Action.count <= Action.source.count and Action.source.cardFromTop(Action.count).rank + 1 = Action.destination.top.rank and Action.source.cardFromTop(Action.count).color != Action.destination.top.color

actions.name: WasteToEmptyTableau
actions.predicate: Action.source.type = Discard and Action.source.visibility = Public and Action.destination.type = Tableau and Action.destination.visibility = Public and Action.source.count > 0 and Action.destination.count = 0 and Action.source.top.rank = 13 and Action.count = 1

actions.name: WasteToTableau
actions.predicate: Action.source.type = Discard and Action.source.visibility = Public and Action.destination.type = Tableau and Action.destination.visibility = Public and Action.source.count > 0 and Action.destination.count > 0 and Action.source.top.rank + 1 = Action.destination.top.rank and Action.source.top.color != Action.destination.top.color and Action.count = 1

actions.name: FoundationToEmptyTableau
actions.predicate: Action.source.type = Foundation and Action.destination.type = Tableau and Action.destination.visibility = Public and Action.source.count > 0 and Action.destination.count = 0 and Action.source.top.rank = 13 and Action.count = 1

actions.name: FoundationToTableau
actions.predicate: Action.source.type = Foundation and Action.destination.type = Tableau and Action.destination.visibility = Public and Action.source.count > 0 and Action.destination.count > 0 and Action.source.top.rank + 1 = Action.destination.top.rank and Action.source.top.color != Action.destination.top.color and Action.count = 1

actions.name: AceToFoundation
actions.predicate: Action.source.type in [Tableau, Discard] and Action.source.visibility = Public and Action.destination.type = Foundation and Action.destination.count = 0 and Action.source.count > 0 and Action.source.top.rank = 1 and Action.source.top.suit = Action.destination.attributes.suit and Action.count = 1

actions.name: BuildFoundation
actions.predicate: Action.source.type in [Tableau, Discard] and Action.source.visibility = Public and Action.destination.type = Foundation and Action.source.count > 0 and Action.destination.count > 0 and Action.source.top.suit = Action.destination.attributes.suit and Action.source.top.rank = Action.destination.top.rank + 1 and Action.count = 1

completion.predicate: GameState.Zones["F1-Hearts"].count = 13 and GameState.Zones["F1-Diamonds"].count = 13 and GameState.Zones["F1-Clubs"].count = 13 and GameState.Zones["F1-Spades"].count = 13
